$comment: The invented dataset the App Store screenshots are taken over (apps/mobile/scripts/screenshots/demo-data.ts). Every name, shop, note and person a screenshot shows comes from here; the numbers, dates and coordinates live in the script, per language. A key is a slot, not a word: `shop.groceries1` is whichever supermarket the persona of that language shops at most, so a translation picks a local shop rather than translating the English one. Plain text only.
